title: China CPI, NBS
description: CPI for China, urban and rural areas: all items, core (ex food and energy), food, non-food, goods, services, 8 categories and subcategories; y/y, YTD and m/m as published by NBS (comparison period = 100, shown as % change), from 1987/1998. NBS data portal via the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/cn/cpi/cn_cpi_dash.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each NBS release by the refresh scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals (once dev-cn is merged).
